content: How well does paragraph-level valence analysis capture negative evaluations of a target group, and thus a major component of dehumanization? To facilitate a qualitative evaluation of this technique, we identify several hundred paragraphs with the highest and lowest average valence. It appears that most paragraphs with high valence scores do express positive evaluations of LGBTQ individuals, and those with low scores express negative evaluations.
